key_points_correct: Correctly maps vulnerabilities to OWASP categories
WAF includes rate limiting, query string blocking, managed rules, geo-blocking
Defense-in-depth covers API gateway, OAuth2 with dual-path migration, CloudTrail, FLE
Good migration strategy for API keys to OAuth2
key_points_missing: BOLA fix allows reads without ownership check (SAFE_METHODS bypass) -- does not fix the stated vulnerability
WAF uses CLOUDFRONT scope instead of REGIONAL for ALB
Geo-block rule blocks the allowed countries instead of blocking others (logic inverted)
key_points_wrong: Geo-match blocks listed countries rather than allowing only those countries
brief_justification: OWASP analysis and defense-in-depth are good. The BOLA fix does not actually prevent the stated vulnerability (accessing other users records via GET), WAF scope is wrong, and geo-blocking logic is inverted.
